pairs.before: Fast mode, in research preview, provides significantly faster output for Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Opus 4.8 at premium pricing. Fast mode pricing applies across the full context window, including requests over 200k input tokens. Fast mode is available on the Claude API (first-party) only; it is not available on Claude Platform on AWS or partner-operated cloud platforms.
pairs.after: Fast mode provides significantly faster output for Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Opus 4.8 at premium pricing. Fast mode for Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 4.8 is in research preview. Fast mode pricing applies across the full context window, including requests over 200k input tokens. Fast mode is available on the Claude API (first-party) and, for Claude Opus 5.5, on Claude in Microsoft Foundry for deployments hosted on Azure; it is not available on Claude Platform on AWS or partner-operated cloud platforms.
